pap_first_paragraph: Wilfrido tabata biba na Weg naar Welgelegen 13. Di akinan e tabata sali sea na pia òf ku bus pa bai bende su bukinan. Den komienso el a purba di tin hende pa yud’e pa distribuí su bukinan. E tabata saka anunsio den su bukinan pa wak si personanan ku tin outo, i ku lo ta dispuesto pa yud’e ku benta. Esaki, sinembargo, tabata kost’é muchu mas di loke e tabata gana for di su benta, i e a opta pa e mes distribuí su bukinan di porta pa porta.
en_first_paragraph: Wilfrido lived at Weg naar Welgelegen 13. From there he set out on foot or by bus to sell his books. At first, he tried to find people willing to help distribute them. He placed notices in his books asking for volunteers with cars who could assist with sales. The cost, however, exceeded what he earned, so he chose to distribute his books himself, door to door.
